patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Adobe Marketo Engage documents a broader use-case set; Uniqode is narrower/specialist.

Comparison thesis: General-purpose vs specialist. Choose Adobe Marketo Engage only if your buying job matches “Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM se” rather than Uniqode's shape. Choose Uniqode only if your buying job matches “Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards for offline→online campaigns — free static QR;” rather than Adobe Marketo Engage's shape. Workflow advantage: Adobe Marketo Engage leans marketing-automation, lead-nurturing; Uniqode leans content-marketing. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Adobe Marketo Engage documents a broader use-case set; Uniqode is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Adobe Marketo Engage is Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM secondary.; Uniqode is Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards for offline→online campaigns — free static QR; paid dynamic from researched ~$9/mo floor..
- Company-size focus: Adobe Marketo Engage (mid-market, enterprise) vs Uniqode (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Adobe Marketo Engage-leaning marketing-automation, lead-nurturing, analytics vs Uniqode-leaning content-marketing.
- Researched limits: Adobe Marketo Engage — Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency; Uniqode — Specialist QR/digital card tool — not a full marketing suite.

Limitations — Adobe Marketo Engage: Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency; Implementation/ops overhead is enterprise-grade; Uniqode: Specialist QR/digital card tool — not a full marketing suite; Plan cards hard to verify without live checkout.

Poor-fit cases: Adobe Marketo Engage is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency · Uniqode is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Specialist QR/digital card tool — not a full marketing suite · Avoid Adobe Marketo Engage if you actually need Uniqode's motion (Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards for offline→online campaigns — free )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
